{{BPFK}}

The following rule (popularly referred to as ''"dotside"'') was proposed:

{{notci|All cmevla must begin and end with a pause or glottal stop, regardless of grammatical context. The syllables '''la''', '''lai''', '''la'i''' and '''doi''' are no longer subject to special restrictions inside cmevla.}}

The membership of the re-authorized BPFK has discussed the matter and voted with 7 votes in favor and 1 abstention. [https://groups.google.com/d/msg/bpfk-list/dnmLsaFk22A/YdnQb8XDDQAJ] The rule is thereby considered part of the officially BPFK-approved standard Lojban.
